intro: The club is run by a student board elected by its members for one academic year.

members.name: President Name
members.bio: Leads the club's strategy and represents the club towards the university, partners and sponsors.

members.name: Treasurer Name
members.bio: Manages the club's finances, budgets for events, and oversees sponsorship agreements.

members.name: Secretary Name
members.bio: Keeps the club organised: member communication, meeting minutes, and event coordination.
